symptom: modelsdk/gen's initAnnotation named a workflow annotation Workflows$AnnotationActivity while the writer overrode it to Workflows$Annotation and the decoder registered both; anything built through the generated constructor would write the other name
cause: the out-of-tree generator took the reflection data's storage alias, which no Mendix version stores; the generator cannot be re-run here, so gen is corrected by hand
insight: Settle a storage-name dispute by measurement, not by the SDK or the codegen comment: write the same small workflow twice (a variant binary with the other name) into fresh 9.24.30 and 11.12.6 apps and run mx check — the wrong name is TypeCacheUnknownTypeException at load, the right one 0 errors. Do not generalise from one alias: CallMicroflowTask is ALSO a codegen alias and is correct before 11.9 (renamed after), so test each alias on the versions it spans. To triage the other 40 aliases cheaply, count alias vs SDK name in the Studio Pro-authored TestApp mxunits (alias present, SDK name absent = confirmed) and check which unconfirmed ones mxcli writes at all; the written ones (EntityEvent, StringExport, ImageViewer) are covered by the doctype mx-check suite.
